sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Binary Authorization: Key concepts
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: rule evaluation modes 'Allow all images', 'Disallow all images', 'Require attestations'; enforcement 'Block and Audit Log' versus 'Dry Run: Audit Log Only'; an attestation is a signed document over the image digest, verified by an attestor's public key; exempt images are always allowed via admissionWhitelistPatterns (patterns can match a whole registry path). The 'Use breakglass' page (read 2026-11-18): the Pod label image-policy.k8s.io/break-glass: 'true' is an 'emergency escape hatch that lets you override Binary Authorization policy enforcement', and 'a breakglass event is automatically logged to Cloud Audit Logs'; the denial message wording is an authored rendering.; the denial message wording is from memory.
